event.resource_depleted: a resource entity of a patch mined out by the force's drill or hand (on_resource_depleted: needs one more forwarded event in control.lua, a mod version change)
event.enemy_seen: an enemy unit, worm or nest charted or within 64 tiles of the force's entities (threat.lua's nest news and attack groups per force)

event.worms: a worm turret seen or hitting the force
event.attacked: the force's buildings attacked the first time (threat.lua attacked areas, per force)
event.loss: the force's first loss incident (losses: buildings destroyed)
event.pollution_attack: an attack group formed from the force's pollution (on_unit_group_finished_gathering)
event.died: an agent of the force died
event.pentapods: a pentapod (wriggler, strafer, stomper) or egg raft seen on Gleba
event.asteroids: the force's platform hit by an asteroid (platform hits, status alerts)
event.spoiled: an item of the force spoiled the first time (spoilage made, item production statistics)
event.low_power: an electric network of the force on low or no power the first time (powercut.lua)
event.second_surface: the force has a platform, or a character on a second planet
event.freight: the force's first cargo pod landed on a surface from a platform

habit.hand_crafts: hand crafts of one recipe (craft calls' counts summed per recipe)
habit.hand_belts: belts placed by build calls (each belt entry counted)
habit.hand_poles: electric poles placed by build calls (each pole entry counted)
habit.hand_feeds: feed calls, and transfer calls that put items into a machine
habit.chest_moves: transfer calls at the same container (by its position)
habit.walked: tiles walked by walk and move_to calls (straight line from where the character stood to the goal, summed)
habit.refused: refusals of the unit's own action (any reason): its dry_run, skip_failed and the like
habit.refused_builds: build, place_ghosts or mine calls refused for the spot (blocked, out of reach, wrong tile)
habit.repeat_calls: calls of one action with the same argument names, each within 10 game minutes of the one before

scale.machines: assemblers, furnaces and chemical plants the force has (get_entity_count by name)
